generated_note: GENERATED comparative pivot of the by_axis station (registry fields only; __ore and TEMPLATED excluded). Truth = by_axis/json — edit there, then re-run node tools/build-template-twins.mjs.

value.label: Independence
value.ask: how much you handle on your own

catalyst.low: You lean on others easily and borrow strength without losing your own.
catalyst.mid: You handle your share and ask for help when the share grows.
catalyst.high: You carry your own weight without being asked, and people count on it.

friction.low: You rarely stand alone, and your line bends to whoever is nearest.
friction.mid: You hold your own line most days and carry a little more than you need to.
friction.high: You carry everything alone, past the point where help would have been faster.

value.label: Competitiveness
value.ask: how much a rival sharpens you

catalyst.low: A rival does little for you, so you set your own bar and meet it.
catalyst.mid: Someone to beat lifts your game when the stakes are real.
catalyst.high: You do your best work with someone to beat, and you usually win.

friction.low: You keep little score, and what you win you rarely count.
friction.mid: You keep a quiet tally with the people closest to you.
friction.high: You keep score with the people you like, and the count costs you friends.

value.label: Solo · Team
value.ask: whether your strength runs best alone or beside people

gloss.low: Your strength runs best beside people, with company to measure against.
gloss.mid: You work alone or with people as the day asks, with no strong pull either way.
gloss.high: Your strength runs best alone, with the room to yourself.

value.label: Intuition
value.ask: how much you learn by your own route

catalyst.low: You learn the taught way and trust what others tested first.
catalyst.mid: You pick things up by your own route when the usual one is slow.
catalyst.high: You understand things nobody taught you, by a route only you can see.

friction.low: Your own hunches get little room, and you wait to be shown.
friction.mid: You keep learning a little past the point of deciding.
friction.high: You keep learning instead of deciding, and the finished thing waits.

value.label: Stability
value.ask: how much solid ground you need before you move

catalyst.low: You move before the ground is solid, and mostly it holds.
catalyst.mid: You want some solid ground before you move, then you move.
catalyst.high: You give people a safe place to think, and you keep one for yourself.

friction.low: You find little shelter in what you know, and you move on quickly.
friction.mid: You stay with what is proven a little longer than it needs.
friction.high: You stay sheltered in what you know, past the point of use.

value.label: Instinct · Research
value.ask: whether you act on what you sense or read up first

gloss.low: You act on what you already sense and read up afterwards, if at all.
gloss.mid: You check a little before you move and trust the rest to instinct.
gloss.high: You read up before you move, and you read a little more after that.

value.label: Warmth
value.ask: how much of you comes out as care

catalyst.low: Care comes out of you in small doses, and it lands when it does.
catalyst.mid: People leave you a little better than they arrived.
catalyst.high: People leave you better fed than they arrived, and they come back for it.

friction.low: You give little away, and what you give you measure.
friction.mid: You give more than you keep, most days.
friction.high: You give until nothing is left for you, and call it being kind.

value.label: Creativity
value.ask: how much of you comes out as the new idea or the sharp line

catalyst.low: You say what works more than what is new, and it works.
catalyst.mid: The new angle comes to you when the usual one has been tried.
catalyst.high: You say the thing nobody else saw, and you say it well.

friction.low: Your sharp line stays in, and the usual words do the job.
friction.mid: The sharp line gets out a little before it is useful.
friction.high: You say the sharp thing before anyone asked, and it lands where it should not.

value.label: Reserved · Expressive
value.ask: how much of what is inside shows on the outside

gloss.low: Most of what is inside stays inside, and people guess the rest.
gloss.mid: You show what the moment needs and keep the rest for later.
gloss.high: What is inside comes out as it comes, and people always know where you stand.

value.label: Ambition
value.ask: how much you reach for the next opening

catalyst.low: The next opening can wait, and you let it.
catalyst.mid: You spot a good chance and take it when the timing is right.
catalyst.high: You spot the chance before others do, and you are already moving.

friction.low: You chase little, and what you start you tend to finish.
friction.mid: You start the next thing a little before this one is done.
friction.high: You chase the next opening before this one is finished, and both pay less.

value.label: Discipline
value.ask: how much you keep what you build

catalyst.low: You keep little of what you build, and you build again easily.
catalyst.mid: What you build mostly stays built, and what you save mostly stays saved.
catalyst.high: What you save and build stays built, and people plan on it.

friction.low: You hold on to little, and what you have slips through.
friction.mid: You hold on a little past the point where letting go would pay.
friction.high: You hold on past the point where letting go would pay, and it costs more than it keeps.

value.label: Focused · Multitasking
value.ask: one thing at a time or several in motion

gloss.low: One thing at a time, finished before the next begins.
gloss.mid: Two things in motion at most, and one of them finished first.
gloss.high: Several things in motion at once, and you keep most of them moving.

value.label: Leadership
value.ask: how much pressure you take on and hand out

catalyst.low: You take pressure when it comes and hand little of it out.
catalyst.mid: In a crisis you get clear, and people notice.
catalyst.high: You are clear in a crisis and others follow, and you went looking for the crisis.

friction.low: You push yourself a little harder than the day asks.
friction.mid: You run yourself hard, and the people near you feel the pace.
friction.high: You run everyone, yourself first, past the point of rest.

value.label: Responsibility
value.ask: how much you answer to the rules you accepted

catalyst.low: You answer to the rules you chose and leave the rest alone.
catalyst.mid: Your word holds, and people plan on it.
catalyst.high: Your word holds without exception, and people build on it.

friction.low: You take on a duty or two more than you can comfortably carry.
friction.mid: You cannot easily say no to a duty, even an unfair one.
friction.high: You cannot say no to a duty, even a bad one, and it costs you sleep.

value.label: Flexible · Structured
value.ask: how much structure you want around you

gloss.low: You want little structure around you and make the plan as you go.
gloss.mid: You want a frame to work in and room to move inside it.
gloss.high: You want the plan set and the rules clear before you start.
